# Code of Conduct

## Our Commitment

UX DataTables is an open source project built around collaboration.

We want everyone participating in the project to feel welcome and respected, regardless of experience level, background, identity, or personal characteristics.

This applies to contributors, maintainers, users, and anyone interacting with the project.

## Expected Behavior

When participating in UX DataTables, please:

- Be respectful and constructive.
- Assume good faith when reviewing issues, pull requests, and discussions.
- Give technical feedback about the code or proposal, not the person behind it.
- Welcome contributors of different experience levels.
- Accept constructive feedback and be willing to reconsider an approach.
- Keep discussions focused on improving the project.
- Clearly explain disagreements when reviewing code or proposing changes.
- Respect maintainers' decisions, while remaining free to discuss them constructively.

Technical disagreement is normal and encouraged when it helps improve the project. Personal attacks are not.

## Unacceptable Behavior

The following behavior is not acceptable:

- Harassment, threats, or intimidation.
- Insults, personal attacks, or deliberately hostile comments.
- Discrimination or derogatory comments based on personal characteristics.
- Trolling or repeatedly disrupting technical discussions.
- Publishing another person's private information without permission.
- Unwanted sexual attention or inappropriate sexualized content.
- Any behavior that would reasonably be considered inappropriate in a professional open source project.

## Project Spaces

This Code of Conduct applies to all UX DataTables community spaces, including:

- GitHub issues;
- pull requests and code reviews;
- GitHub Discussions;
- documentation contributions;
- release and support discussions;
- other spaces where someone is representing UX DataTables.

## Enforcement

The maintainer may edit or remove comments, close or lock discussions, reject contributions, or temporarily or permanently restrict participation when behavior violates this Code of Conduct.

Moderation decisions should be proportional to the situation and made with the goal of maintaining a healthy environment for contributors and users.

## Reporting an Incident

If you experience or witness behavior that violates this Code of Conduct, please contact the maintainer privately using the contact information provided in this repository.

Please do not open a public GitHub issue to report harassment or other sensitive incidents.

Reports will be handled as confidentially as reasonably possible.
